title: Persuasion at Play: Understanding Misinformation Dynamics in Demographic-Aware Human-LLM Interactions
findings: When presented with misinformation targeting a religious group ('Illegal Muslim From Iran...'), an LLM-generated refutation correctly identified the use of the religious label as a 'deliberate attempt to create fear & stir up prejudice'. Additionally, when prompted to generate beliefs for demographic personas, models associated 'faith and spirituality' with rural and older adult personas, reflecting socially-grounded stereotypes.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured LLM and human susceptibility to persuasive misinformation. In the context of religion, this included evaluating an LLM's ability to refute a piece of misinformation that used a religious stereotype (specifically, 'Illegal Muslim') to stir prejudice. It also measured the inclusion of 'faith and spirituality' as core beliefs when LLMs were prompted to generate demographic personas (e.g., rural, old).
